name: Dark Predation
description: Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies.

stats.INTERVAL: 0.9s, with a 0.1s interval between each tendril

name: Feast of the Abyss
description: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by pressing {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Left-Click | PS5 = link=| | Xbox = link=|}}, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemies current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing.

stats.CASTING: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.DAMAGE: Inflict damage equal to 50% of the target's health, followed by an additional 50 damage
stats.MOVEMENT BOOST: Increases movement speed by 80% while active

name: Cellular Corrosion
description: Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage

stats.CASTING: Spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.DAMAGE: Deals 5 damage to nearby enemies, and an additional 80 damage if the target remains in the area at the end of the duration.

name: Venom Swing
description: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction

name: Symbiotic Resilience
description: Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's health, the greater the Bonus Health generated.

stats.BONUS HEALTH: Grant 100 Bonus Health and convert 120% of missing health into Bonus Health

name: Frenzied Arrival
description: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, Launching Them Up towards the landing point.

stats.DAMAGE: 65 damage, with damage falloff starting at 2m from the center of the spell field and decreasing to 40% at 6m

name: Alien Biology
description: Press {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Space | PS5 = link=| | Xbox = link=|}} to wall crawl, and while crawling, press {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Left-Click | PS5 = link=| | Xbox =  link=|}} to sprint.

name: Healing Tendrils
description: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff the Land Shark and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies for continuous healing, releasing a large healing burst that converts any excess into Bonus Health when it ends. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere that pulls in nearby enemies and links them, slowing those that try to escape.
